en.hubeali:
Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Muhammad Bin Isa, from Abdullah Bin Sinan, 
Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> has said:
‘Circumcision of the boy is from the Sunnah, and cutting (the genitals) of the girls is not from the Sunnah’.
en.sarwar: 2. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from ‘Abd Allah ibn Sinan who has said the following: “Abu ’Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘
Circumcision for boys is because of Sunnah but circumcision for girls is not because of Sunnah.”’
